UAF Graduate School
Get to know UAF’s range of advanced study opportunities for graduate students.
Browse Programs
Graduate Studies that Propel Your Career Forward
UAF graduate programs offer exceptional value, blending rigorous academics, hands-on
research and career-focused opportunities in one of the most unique environments on
Earth. With a strong return on investment, our programs prepare you for high-demand
fields while fostering innovation and expertise. With our location in the heart of
the state, Fairbanks affords us access to Alaska’s natural laboratory, offering unmatched
opportunities for research and career growth. Programs like interdisciplinary studies
allow students to design customized degrees by integrating multiple fields of study,
ensuring their education aligns perfectly with their goals.
Ready to adventure North?
1,043 Graduate Students
66 Graduate Programs
$174M Annual Research Funding
Join us in Fairbanks! Spend your graduate years studying at the farthest North university
in the U.S. — beyond the Alaskan mountain range, beneath the northern lights. UAF
offers post-baccalaureate certificates, graduate certificates, master's degrees and
doctoral degrees. Where will your degree take you?

Research Drives Your Graduate Experience at UAF
At UAF, research is at the heart of the graduate experience, offering opportunities
to tackle pressing global challenges. From Arctic ecosystems to cutting-edge climate
science, students collaborate on transformative projects that drive innovation. Explore
how you can make an impact through research.
Explore Research at UAF
Graduate Student Spotlights
Our students’ stories showcase the variety, innovation and impact of UAF’s graduate
community. From groundbreaking research to meaningful community engagement, these
profiles highlight how UAF supports success at every stage. Explore their journeys
and be inspired by what’s possible when you join the Nanook community.
View Grad Spotlights
Personalized Support With an Admission Coordinator
If you have questions about UAF or the admissions process, please feel free to send
them our way. Our graduate admissions team offers personalized, one-on-one support
to help you navigate your journey. Reach out to get the guidance and answers you need
to take the next step with confidence.
